note: City of Keithsburg campground on the open Mississippi bank below town, in the pool above Lock and Dam 18; the front row backs onto a sand beach 30-40 m from the water. Three boat ramps, fish-cleaning station, playground. --Claude
summary: City page read: $22 (rows 2-4) / $25 (river front, full hookup), FCFS, May 1-Sep 30 (flood-dependent), ~70 W/E + 15 FHU sites, showers, two dumps; phone 309-507-6919 matches. Riverfront confirmed: front-row pads 30-40 m from the water over open sand, riverside of the high ground. Pin within ~25 m of the rows. Note cleaned.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored riverfront, not --AWH): KEEP riverfront. Levee check: the 3DEP transect has the campground on the river side - water 162.55 m, front-row pads ~163.6-163.8 m, rows 2-4 164-165 m, and a 168.8-170.6 m ridge (levee/high ground) ~230-260 m inland with lower ground (167.3-167.6 m) behind it, so nothing stands between the rows and the river. The front ('River front', $25) row: back-in pads along the river side of the campground road, e.g. around 41.09728,-90.94312 and 41.09683,-90.94268, pad ends 30-40 m from the water across an open sand beach (Esri, 0.29 m/px). The Mississippi is ~800 m wide here. Front-row sites are sold by the night (FCFS); site numbers are not published, so the qualifying sites are named by row.

PIN: stored 41.09697,-90.94235 sits in the middle of the three rows (~25 m from their centre): keep. A cluster of RVs ~200 m north at ~41.0985,-90.9437 (beside the boat-ramp lot) may be the 15 added full-hookup sites; same campground and entrance.

LONG-STAY: local (city) campground; 'monthly rates are available' but nightly rates are posted first and the campground is first-come. Many RVs were parked on the Esri capture; the share of monthly campers is not published. No wording discourages nightly guests. Not flagged.
PHONE: 309-507-6919 (campground phone on the city page) matches - keep. WEBSITE: keep https://www.cityofkeithsburg.com/campground.
HOOKUPS: amperage not stated on the city page; electric left unset.
